g.text: Megatron-LM 1.28B on one Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201), FineWeb-Edu, 1000 iterations × 16k tokens

Train loss: each point is Megatron's mean over 10 iterations (log interval 10), plotted without further smoothing. Validation: fixed 2% of FineWeb-Edu documents, every 100 iterations (327k tokens), at its true
iteration. Wall-clock is training time only (startup and evaluation excluded).
